messages.author: 6386efe35e9d5a40
messages.subject: Deducer on Xubuntu 12.04
parts:
I'm having difficulties installing Deducer on a fresh installation of Xubuntu...latest release (12.04). Anyone else use this distribution or any other Ubuntu flavor of the latest release? 

I get the following configuration errors. 

configure: error: One or more Java configuration variables are not set.
Make sure R is configured with full Java support (including JDK). Run
R CMD javareconf
as root to add Java support to R.

If you don't have root privileges, run
R CMD javareconf -e
to set all Java-related variables and then install rJava.

Following these instructions doesn't seem to matter.

Thanks! Deducer is fantastic and I'll change distros to use it if I have to!

BC

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Deducer on Xubuntu 12.04
parts:
Bart,

can you provide the full output of R CMD javareconf. Also, make sure
that your Java installation has all of the right variables set. If
your Java install is not set up correctly, it can not be configured
with R.


best,
Ian

messages.subject: Installation issue
parts:
First, it doesn't sound like you are using  Linux as the message subject implied. What operating system are you on? 

Second, do you have java installed on your machine? If not install it.

Third, you will want to run jgr through the launcher. 

Follow the instructions on deducer.org


Best
Ian
